title: Captured manifests, read gates and crash recovery

tests.name: test/faults/publication.test.js
tests.detail: crash injected before a component write, after the write but before its ack, and after the ack but before catalog publication; recovery serves the old view completely or the new view completely

findings: observedSeq is never substituted for an applied view; a read is served from appliedManifestId.
An applying store does not serve, and does not serve the previous revision label while partially mutated.
Two projections at different applied manifests is a detectable mixed-views condition, not a guess the reader has to make.
knownLimitations: Same as U04: implemented and tested, not yet the gate in front of the derived indexes.
rollback: Not on the default query path.
